title: [TypeInfo] Fix `Type::fromValue` incorrectly setting object type instead of enum

Tried to apply https://github.com/symfony/symfony/pull/60820#discussion_r2156719402 comment, but found some failing cases

ground_truth.body: Potential performance impact from `is_subclass_of` call in enum detection, which must execute for every object and cannot be moved lower without breaking enum handling logic.
ground_truth.diff_hunk:
@@ -412,6 +412,7 @@ public static function fromValue(mixed $value): Type
         }
 
         $type = match (true) {
+            \is_object($value) && is_subclass_of($value::class, \UnitEnum::class) => Type::enum($value::class),
             \is_object($value) => \stdClass::class === $value::class ? self::object() : self::object($value::class),
             \is_array($value) => self::builtin(TypeIdentifier::ARRAY),
             default => null,
